title: Off-planet pin given at Cape Canaveral

tellings.quote: Well, uh that pen was given to me by uh someone everybody has read about right down at Cape Canaveral without saying names.

plain: Sometime between 2007 and 2010, at Cape Canaveral, the Florida launch site, a person "everybody has read about" gave Chris Bledsoe what the story calls an off-planet pin, he tells Michels. Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says UFOs show up around him and whom NASA has taken an interest in, says he got it himself but tells it "without saying names". The name Timothy Taylor is attached to the story, though how is not spelled out.
